messages:
Clara (AE): quick heads up — Hightide POC is blocked, legal and pricing need final signoff before we can go live. customer is pushing for an exec touchpoint. @Evan (Sales) can you pull finance in?
Evan (Sales): on it. pinging @Omar (Finance) — can you join a 30m bridge? they want committed pricing for reserved capacity + data residency confirmation.
Omar (Finance): ok i can join. need the draft T&Cs and the expected qps to run a cost run. Clara, do we have the estimator and invoice preview?
Clara (AE): attaching the estimator link — https://redwood.internal/proposals/hightide-poc-est.csv (small note: they asked about dedicated vs hosted pricing). customer preference: dedicated for data isolation.
Priya (Solutions): also note: their workload uses long context (4k) and high concurrency during batch runs. I recommended batching + kv-cache; if they choose dedicated we can offer a limited burst discount.
Jamal (Security): legal flagged two items in questionnaire: 1) KMS BYOK integration (they require HSM attestation), 2) data residency in eu-west-1 only. We have a template for BYOK + HSM flow but needs SOC2 appendix.
Deniz (Customer Success): customer is worried about timeline — they gave internal deadline next Tue. They said delay in pricing stalls their procurement.
Evan (Sales): can we do an interim exec note: we confirm data residency and BYOK is supported with caveats; finance will give provisional numbers pending final qps. that should unblock procurement.
Omar (Finance): provisional numbers sent to me: Clara, Priya — please drop expected 95th p95 latency, avg tokens per call, and expected monthly tokens. I need those to run reserve pricing.
Clara (AE): sent: p95 180ms, avg 120 tokens per call, est monthly 75M tokens. also adding a note that they want a 1yr commit with quarterly ramp.
Priya (Solutions): added technical note for BYOK: we support KMS with customer-owned key in Private deploys and Dedicated with peering + HSM attestation via our partner flow. Legal will still need the attestation doc.
Jamal (Security): i'll prepare the attestation snippet and SOC2 appendix draft tonight, then loop in Legal for signoff. ETA: 24h.
Evan (Sales): great. Clara — can you book 30m bridge tomorrow 10am PT with Hightide execs, @Omar, @Jamal, @Priya, and me? I'll prep an exec note summarizing provisional pricing + technical mitigations.
Clara (AE): booked — invite sent. will include meeting agenda: 1) provisional pricing, 2) BYOK + residency, 3) rollout timeline.
OpsBot: Ticket #REQ-6382 created: "Hightide POC — BYOK attestation + provisional pricing run" assigned to Finance/Security/Solutions.
Omar (Finance): after i run the numbers i can propose two options: a) 12mo commit w/ 10% discount, b) 6mo trial + higher per-token. i'll post the calc before the bridge.
Deniz (Customer Success): i'll send a short note to the customer to confirm bridge and that we will provide provisional pricing + attestations. helps cool procurement.
Clara (AE): thanks all — primary blockers: (1) legal signoff on SOC2 appendix (Jamal -> Legal) (2) finance provisional numbers (Omar) (3) customer exec bridge scheduled. we'll track here; please flag if anything slips. :thumbsup:
Evan (Sales): if we get attestation + provisional pricing before the bridge we should be able to get procurement to approve the PO within a week. moving to action items.
Jamal (Security): uploading draft attestation doc to the shared drive now — link: https://redwood.internal/security/hightide-attest-draft.md
Clara (AE): perfect. i'll compile a one-pager for the execs.
Evan (Sales): status check at 9am PT tomorrow — everyone confirm by then.
Deniz (Customer Success): noted. i'll nudge customer after the 9am check.
Clara (AE): closing loop for now. will update thread after 9am check.
